nieuw.titel: Consider White Sword for a Spectral Doppelganger Archmage
nieuw.tekst: For a High Elf Spectral Doppelganger build, he favours the White Sword for its usefulness against a wider range of units than the Dragon Slaying Sword.
nieuw.waarom: He says the White Sword adds three Strength and AP minus two, making Spectral Doppelganger effective at inflicting wounds and winning combats against different units rather than serving only a narrow monster-killing role.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says the White Sword requires its bearer to be on foot or a chariot.

extraCitaten.citaat: gives you plus three strength and AP minus two

nieuw.titel: Mount the White Sword Archmage on a Skycutter
nieuw.tekst: He recommends the Lothern Skycutter as a mount for the White Sword and Spectral Doppelganger Archmage.
nieuw.waarom: He values the protection from Killing Blow and Monster Slayer, together with the combined seven wounds and four-plus armour save.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says taking Lore Familiar to guarantee Spectral Doppelganger uses up the build's 100-point magic-item allowance.

bronnen.citaat: it means that you can't be killing blowed and you can't be monster slayed

nieuw.titel: Choose Glittering Robe to protect the Skycutter Archmage
nieuw.tekst: He likes taking Glittering Robe alongside Spectral Doppelganger for his Skycutter-mounted Archmage, to help defend the chariot against shooting and close-combat attacks.
nieuw.waarom: He says the chariot is vulnerable to hits in both the shooting and combat phases.

nieuw.titel: Consider lesser wizards carrying Dispel Scrolls for critical spells
nieuw.tekst: He has had some success using lesser wizards with Dispel Scrolls to stop a critical opposing spell on turn two or three.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that spells have different values at different stages of the game, making the timing of magical defence important.

extraCitaten.citaat: you sort of want to dispel that critical spell on turn two or turn three

nieuw.titel: Plan when to attack the opposing wizard
nieuw.tekst: During deployment, decide whether to avoid the opposing level-four wizard's dispel bubble or attack the wizard, and on which turn. Judge the timing against its magic's range, the risks you accept and the units you are willing to sacrifice.
nieuw.waarom: He says magic's importance changes over the game, and sacrificing units can be worthwhile if it prevents the opposing wizard from influencing the battle.

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: His Griffon restrained and reformed after an opposing unit gave ground, then charged the enemy wizard. This stopped the wizard dispelling while his Archmage cast Spectral Doppelganger and killed the enemy general.
aanvullingen.toelichting: The same recommendation to engage the opposing wizard before casting a crucial spell, including using an expendable mobile attacker.
